privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
At La Rufeta, we respect your privacy. The data you provide through the reservation form is used exclusively to manage your booking and is not shared with third parties.

Data Controller: La Rufeta
Purpose: Reservation management
Rights: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.

To exercise your rights, contact us at +34 676 93 93 54.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.content:

Analytics cookies: We use Plausible Analytics (privacy-friendly, no persistent cookies).

You can manage your cookie preferences at any time.
